title: 第23章 府内宣旨第24章 离京
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 而一些老成持重的勋贵和老臣，如英国公张维，则是眼中精光一闪，敏锐地察觉到这道旨意背后必然与昨日方老太君入宫有关。
陛下此举，看似退让，实则是以最小的代价快速平息北境可能爆发的巨祸，同时……似乎也将方家再次推到风口浪尖。
他捋着发白的胡须，沉默不语，心中暗叹。“方家……终究还是被卷了进来。”
“众卿可有异议？”乾帝淡淡开口，声音不大，却带着一股无形的压力，瞬间压下朝堂上的窃窃私语。
无人敢在此刻触怒已有决断的皇帝。
“陛下圣明！”群臣齐声应和，只是这声音中，包含太多的复杂情绪。
紧接着，第二道旨意下达，任命礼部右侍郎李文翰为钦差大臣，即日启程，押运首批足额粮饷前往北境宣旨安抚，并全权处理相关事宜。
李文翰是帝党中人，虽为文臣，但做事干练，深得乾帝信任。
让他去，既显示朝廷的重视，也确保旨意能够准确执行，同时……或许也负有监视之责。
退朝的钟声响起，百官怀着满腹的疑惑和猜测，缓缓退出金銮殿。
乾帝看着臣子们离去背影，嘴角勾起一丝难以察觉的冷意。快刀斩乱麻，先稳住北境再说。
至于方家……他倒真想要看看，弱小孤寡的他们能玩出什么花样。
与此同时的方府，依旧笼罩在一种悲凉与紧张交织的气氛中。
突然，府门外传来一阵急促马蹄声和甲胄碰撞的铿锵之音。
福伯急匆匆赶来禀报，“老太君，小少爷，宫里有天使携圣旨到了发府！”
老太君与方云逸对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到一丝凝重。来了，这比他们预想中的还要快上不少。
“开中门，设香案，准备接旨！”
老太君迅速下令，尽管此刻心中波澜起伏，面上却维持着镇定。
只在片刻后，方府略显破败但打扫干净的前院中，香案已然设好。
一队盔明甲亮、气息精悍的禁军士兵分列两侧，肃杀之气弥漫。
为首一名面白无须、眼神锐利的中年太监，手持明黄圣旨，昂然而立，正是前日来过方府的王公公。
老太君在赵嚒嚒的搀扶下，站在最前方，她身着诰命服制，虽然老旧，却显得庄重。
方云逸则站在她身侧稍后位置，脸色带着不健康的苍白，由福伯虚扶着，显得有些弱不禁风。
府中其余仆役，包括赵嬷嬷一家和福伯的侄子，则皆恭敬地跪在后方。
王公公目光扫过众人，在方云逸身上略微停留一瞬。陛下特许，方公子年弱体虚，又有伤势在身，无需跪迎旨意。
话音落下，随即展开手中的圣旨，尖细的声音朗朗响起。
“诏曰：咨尔方氏，忠烈遗孤，一门英杰，为朝捐躯，朕心常恻。”
“今北境不稳，需赖旧勋。”
“特准方老太君所请，着方家子孙云逸，携家书前往北境，宣慰将士，祭奠先灵，以安边陲，以慰忠魂。”
“兹事体大，特允方云逸随钦差大臣李文翰同行，即日出发，不得延误。”
content_en:
Some mature and prudent nobles and ministers, such as the British Duke Zhang Wei, had a flash of light in their eyes, and they keenly realized that this decree must be related to the entry of Mrs. Fang into the palace yesterday.
His Majesty's move may seem like a concession, but in fact it is a way to quickly quell the potential disaster in the north at the minimum cost. At the same time... it seems to have pushed the Fang family to the forefront of the storm again.
He stroked his white beard and remained silent, sighing inwardly. "The Fang family... was eventually involved."
"Do you have any objections?" Emperor Qian said calmly, his voice was not loud, but with an invisible pressure, he instantly suppressed the whispers in the court.
No one dared to offend the emperor who had made a decision at this moment.
"Your Majesty, Your Majesty!" The ministers responded in unison, but this voice contained too many complex emotions.
Immediately afterwards, the second decree was issued, appointing Li Wenhan, the right minister of the Ministry of Rites, as the imperial envoy. He set off on the same day to escort the first batch of sufficient food and salary to the northern border to proclaim the decree and appease him, and to handle related matters with full authority.
Li Wenhan was a member of the imperial party. Although he was a civil servant, he was capable in doing things and won the trust of Emperor Qian.
Letting him go not only shows the importance of the court, but also ensures that the will can be carried out accurately. At the same time... he may also have the responsibility of monitoring.
The retreat bell rang, and all the officials slowly exited the Jinluan Palace with full of doubts and speculations.
Emperor Qian looked at the departing figures of his ministers, with an imperceptible coldness on his lips. To cut through the mess quickly, first stabilize the northern border.
As for the Fang family... he really wanted to see what tricks they, weak and lonely, could pull off.
At the same time, the Fang Mansion was still shrouded in an atmosphere of sadness and tension.
Suddenly, there was a loud sound of rapid horse hooves and the clash of armors outside the house.
Uncle Fu hurried over to report, "Old lady, young master, an angel from the palace has arrived at Fafu with an imperial edict!"
The old lady and Fang Yunyi looked at each other and saw a hint of solemnity in each other's eyes. Here it comes, much faster than they expected.
"Open the middle door, set up the incense table, and prepare to receive the order!"
The old lady quickly ordered. Although her heart was turbulent at the moment, her face remained calm.
Only a moment later, the incense table was set up in the slightly dilapidated but clean front yard of Fang Mansion.
A group of Forbidden Army soldiers with bright helmets and powerful auras lined up on both sides, filled with a murderous atmosphere.
The first one was a middle-aged eunuch with a white face and sharp eyes, holding a bright yellow imperial edict and standing proudly. He was the prince who had visited Fang Mansion the day before yesterday.
The old lady, supported by Zhao Dongdong, stood at the front. She was wearing imperial uniform. Although she was old, she looked solemn.
Fang Yunyi stood a little behind her, with an unhealthy pale face. He was supported by Fu Boxu, looking a little frail.
The rest of the servants in the mansion, including Aunt Zhao's family and Uncle Fu's nephew, all knelt respectfully in the back.
The prince's gaze swept across the crowd and paused for a moment on Fang Yunyi. Your Majesty's permission, Young Master Fang is weak and injured, so he does not need to kneel to accept the decree.
After the words fell, he immediately unfolded the imperial edict in his hand, and a high-pitched voice sounded loudly.
"The imperial edict says: I am deeply saddened by the fact that you, the Fang clan, was an orphan of a loyal and loyal family, a hero of a distinguished family, and sacrificed his life for the dynasty."
"Today's northern border is unstable and we need to rely on our old heroes."
"At the request of Mrs. Fang, I am going to the north with Yunyi, a descendant of the Fang family, and a family letter to express my condolences to the soldiers and pay homage to the ancestors, so as to calm the border and comfort the loyal souls."
"Since the matter is serious, Fang Yunyi is specially allowed to accompany the Imperial Envoy Li Wenhan. We will set off today without any delay."
